avoid_supplements.name: Anthracycline-containing herbal products
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Concurrent cardiotoxic agents increase risk of cardiomyopathy and heart failure when combined with trastuzumab's known cardiotoxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid all supplements containing anthracycline derivatives or cardiotoxic botanicals

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin C (>2g daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate oxidative stress and cardiac dysfunction in setting of trastuzumab-induced cardiotoxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin C intake to <1g daily; use only under oncology supervision

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have immunostimulatory effects that could theoretically interfere with monoclonal antibody therapy efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced therapeutic response; discuss with oncologist before use

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild cardioprotective effects that could be beneficial but require monitoring in cardiotoxicity risk
caution_supplements.action: Use appropriate doses (≤3g daily) under medical supervision for cardiac monitoring

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: While trastuzumab is not CYP3A4 metabolized, grapefruit may alter immune function and increase cardiac stress in vulnerable populations
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit products from diet during trastuzumab therapy

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May exacerbate fluid retention and cardiac stress in patients with trastuzumab-induced cardiomyopathy
caution_foods.action: Maintain moderate sodium intake (<2.3g daily); monitor for edema and weight gain

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (moderate to heavy consumption)
caution_foods.mechanism: May potentiate cardiotoxicity and impair immune function; increases dehydration and cardiac strain
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol to ≤1 drink daily or avoid entirely; discuss with oncology team

monitoring_notes: Trastuzumab is a monoclonal antibody not metabolized by hepatic enzymes, so traditional drug-supplement interactions are limited. Primary concern is cardiotoxicity risk; monitor baseline and periodic echocardiography, and counsel patients on cardiac risk factors including supplements/foods that stress cardiovascular function.
